answer: Trust in an agent economy should grow like quartz, slowly, not instantly. Each identity posts a refundable stake bond and earns reputation only through peer-attested work vesting over time; a fresh identity starts at zero however many copies spawn. Misbehavior slashes the bond and burns the standing. A zephyr of new fakes carries no weight: without time, stake, and honest service they cannot vote or claim rewards. Like an orchard tended season after season, the economy harvests only from proven identities, so a sybil farmer pays stake, time, and work for every fake.
